card.name: Punctuation before US city or publisher
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small linking words right before a US city, publisher location or street address, mostly in reference lists and addresses. It fires where a place name like Baltimore, Washington or Miami is expected next.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Period or comma after a book title or edition, just before the publisher and its US city.
modes.example: Walker's Mammals of the World<<.>> Johns Hopkins University Press, Baltimore, Maryland

modes.label: Street address
modes.description: Street abbreviation or number inside a US street address in Washington, DC.

modes.label: Local transit or place lists
modes.description: Linking words or commas in descriptions of a US city's services or institutions.
modes.example: bus, Metromover,<< and>> Metrorail—an elevated rapid transit system

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese place names like province and lake and away from New York and Manhattan terms.
card.plain: It marks spots in citations and addresses where a US city name is about to come next.
